release_notes: Build 106 simplifies the Quiz History action bar now that the C: to Z: migration is complete.
The normal Quiz History screen no longer shows the old Match archive, Archive selected, or Update paths recovery controls.
Archive completed C remains available as the supported ongoing archive/catch-up action and is now labelled Archive C → Z.
Questions, Metadata, YouTube, Folder, Delete and Refresh remain unchanged for day-to-day use.
Legacy archive matching, manual archive and path-recovery implementation remains in the codebase for emergency maintenance, but its UI is no longer registered during normal startup.
The old archive diagnostic/persistence UI hooks are also no longer registered on normal startup because they were tied to the retired Match archive workflow.
Build 105 SEO audit improvements and Build 103-104 archive/SEO changes remain included unchanged.
